candidates.source_name: OTP Bank Nyrt. – Befektetőknek (IR hub, HU)
candidates.why_relevant: Root of the densest disclosure estate in Hungarian banking: routes to annual reports, quarterly flash reports (gyorsjelentés), interim management reports, financial calendar, announcements and analyst material for OTP Group and its country segments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the IR section tree (jelentesek / tozsdei-jelentesek / eves-jelentes / penzugyi-naptar) with PDF harvesting keyed on the financial calendar dates.
queries_used: OTP Bank befektetői kapcsolatok éves jelentés gyorsjelentés

candidates.source_name: OTP Bank – Pénzügyi naptár / Befektetői Kapcsolatok Naptár (financial calendar)
candidates.why_relevant: Gives forward-looking publication dates for earnings, AGM and reports — the scheduling backbone for any recurring collection routine against OTP.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Light periodic scrape to build a release-date schedule; drive the document crawler from it.
queries_used: OTP Bank befektetői kapcsolatok éves jelentés gyorsjelentés

candidates.source_name: OTP Group – Investor Relations (English IR estate, otpgroup.info)
candidates.why_relevant: English-language mirror/extension of OTP's IR: IFRS reports, integrated annual reports, conference-call presentations, reporting schedule. Usually the easiest machine-readable path for cross-country comparison and for the country-segment detail on Hungary.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /investor-relations/reports subtrees (annual, ifrs) and presentation pages; store PDF/XLSX and the quarterly presentation decks.
queries_used: OTP Bank investor relations annual report quarterly presentation English

candidates.source_name: OTP Bank – IR közlemények (regulated announcements archive by year)
candidates.why_relevant: Year-indexed archive of regulated/extraordinary announcements (acquisitions, bond closings, capital actions) — the fastest early signal of strategic moves before they reach reports.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Year-path enumeration crawl (…/ir/kozlemenyek/{year}) with diffing against last-seen item list.
queries_used: OTP Bank sajtószoba sajtóközlemények hírek otpbank.hu média

candidates.source_name: OTP Bank – Hírek / sajtóközlemények (corporate news & press releases)
candidates.why_relevant: Non-regulated commercial and product communication (pricing, digital services, card/POS initiatives) that regulated filings do not carry; important for payments-side intelligence.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic listing scrape; treat as marketing-inflected, cross-check against IR filings.
queries_used: OTP Bank sajtószoba sajtóközlemények hírek otpbank.hu média

candidates.source_name: OTP Jelzálogbank Zrt. – Pénzügyi információk (covered-bond issuer disclosures)
candidates.why_relevant: Separate Hungarian-domiciled bond-issuing entity inside OTP Group; mortgage-bond (jelzáloglevél) programme and transparency reporting expose funding structure and mortgage-book quality not visible at group level.

candidates.source_name: MBH Bank Nyrt. – Befektetőknek / közzétételek (HU investor estate)
candidates.why_relevant: Post-merger MBH (MKB+Takarék+Budapest Bank) is Hungary's #2 bank; as a bond issuer it publishes near-issuer-grade financial statements, extraordinary announcements and prospectuses. Legacy paths still carry 'mkb-bankrol' segments, which matters for crawler design.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl both the current and legacy path trees (befektetoi/befektetoknek/... incl. /mkb-bankrol/penzugyi-jelentesek); note annual reports are shipped as digitally signed ZIP/ESEF, so unpack before parsing.
queries_used: MBH Bank kötvénykibocsátás befektetői tájékoztató éves jelentés

candidates.source_name: MBH Bank – Investor Relations (English, mbhbank.com)
candidates.why_relevant: Separate English IR domain carrying investor reports, announcements and an 'International issues' section for the EUR EMTN programme, base prospectus, supplements and senior-preferred investor presentations — the richest strategy-level MBH material.

candidates.why_relevant: Base prospectuses are the single richest structured description of a Hungarian bank: business model, risk factors, group structure, funding, litigation, and segment financials — all in one MNB-approved document, refreshed annually.

candidates.source_name: Budapesti Értéktőzsde (BÉT/BSE) – Kibocsátói közzétételek / KIBINFO news database
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory publication venue for every BÉT-listed issuer (OTP, Gránit, MBH group entities, OPUS, 4iG). Single funnel that catches filings even when an issuer's own site lags; document PDFs are served from stable /newkibdata/{id}/ paths, making it the most automatable single node in this cell.

candidates.source_name: MNB Közzétételek (kozzetetelek.mnb.hu) – officially appointed storage mechanism (OAM)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory OAM for all Hungarian regulated information: every listed/bond-issuing bank must file regular and extraordinary disclosures and inside information here. Legally complete backstop for the whole cell, and the authoritative record when an issuer site is restructured.
candidates.legal_status: statutory public repository under Tpt./EU Transparency rules
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query per issuer and pull via the downloadkozzetetel?id=…&did=… document endpoint pattern; keep the returned document IDs as stable keys. Also track the MNB ESEF/APM vezetői körlevél for format changes.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on the statutory storage mechanism
queries_used: kozzetetelek.mnb.hu szabályozott információk hivatalosan kijelölt tárolási rendszer kibocsátó

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, standalone English-language IR portal was found for GRÁNIT Bank Nyrt.; the confirmed IR tree at granitbank.hu/befektetoknek is Hungarian-only in the sections observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hungarian searches returned a full HU IR structure; no en/ equivalent path surfaced in either HU or EN searching.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any Gránit monitoring must run on Hungarian-language parsing; English-only pipelines would silently miss Hungary's newest listed bank.

negative_findings.description: MBH Bank's disclosure estate is split across at least four hosts (mbhbank.hu, mbhbank.com, mbhbefektetesibank.hu, mbhjelzalogbank.hu) and still carries legacy 'mkb-bankrol' URL segments from the pre-merger entities.
negative_findings.result_summary: Documents for a single issuer group were found on four distinct domains during this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A single-domain crawler will under-collect MBH badly; the collection config must enumerate all four hosts and tolerate legacy paths.

negative_findings.description: MBH Bank's annual report is distributed as a digitally signed ZIP (ESEF-style) rather than a plain PDF, and MNB has issued a vezetői körlevél on ESEF/APM reporting for issuers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search result text explicitly describes the annual report as available in digitally signed zip format.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Text extraction must unpack ZIP/iXBRL packages; a PDF-only parser will register these filings as missing.

negative_findings.description: No K&H Jelzálogbank investor/disclosure estate could be located; Hungarian searches returned Erste and UniCredit mortgage-bank pages but nothing substantive for K&H.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hungarian query naming K&H Jelzálogbank produced no K&H-specific disclosure page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either the entity does not exist under that name or it does not issue publicly; must not be assumed present in the issuer universe without confirmation.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice come from search results, issuer document links, or (for granitbank.hu/befektetoknek) a single successful page read. Liveness of the remainder was not tested and is left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: One page fetched successfully; no URL here is claimed as verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false confidence; deep static-file paths on issuer sites in particular rotate between prospectus vintages.

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian-domiciled banks that issue bonds but sit under foreign parents (K&H/KBC, Raiffeisen Bank Zrt., CIB, Erste Bank Hungary as opposed to its mortgage bank) were only partially explored in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sweep for 'Zrt. éves beszámoló / közzététel / kötvény' on each foreign-parent Hungarian bank subsidiary to find Hungary-only statutory reporting.

coverage_gaps.description: Earnings-call audio/transcripts for OTP were only located via a gated third-party aggregator; the issuer's own conference-call recordings/transcripts page was not pinned to a specific URL.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch otpgroup.info presentation/results pages directly to locate first-party webcast and transcript assets, avoiding aggregator licence issues.

coverage_gaps.description: The MNB OAM (kozzetetelek.mnb.hu) search/query interface and any bulk or per-issuer listing endpoint were not mapped; only the download URL pattern was observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Interactively map the OAM search form and its query parameters to enable per-issuer, date-bounded harvesting of regulated disclosures.

coverage_gaps.description: BÉT's per-issuer 'Közzétételek' tab URLs and any RSS/news feed for KIB disclosures were not captured as concrete endpoints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Navigate Kibocsátók → Kibocsátók listája for OTP, GRÁNIT, MBH Jelzálogbank, OPUS and 4iG and record each issuer's stable disclosure-tab URL and feed if one exists.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-specific disclosure (card/POS/acquiring volumes, instant-payment metrics) inside these issuers' reports was not separately located; it is likely embedded in segment sections of annual reports and investor presentations rather than in dedicated documents.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: During collection, extract at section level and index on terms like 'kártyaforgalom', 'elfogadói hálózat', 'POS terminál', 'azonnali fizetés' to surface payments data inside general filings.

brief: Hungary's listed/bond-issuing bank IR estate is unusually concentrated and unusually well-documented: OTP alone (otpbank.hu HU IR + otpgroup.info EN IR + OTP Jelzálogbank) supplies annual and integrated reports, quarterly flash reports, presentations, a published financial calendar and a year-indexed announcement archive, making it the single densest node in the landscape. MBH is the second pillar but its material is fragmented across four domains (mbhbank.hu, mbhbank.com, mbhbefektetesibank.hu, mbhjelzalogbank.hu) and distributed in ESEF/signed-ZIP form, with the HUF 500bn base prospectus and the EUR EMTN investor presentations carrying the richest strategy detail; GRÁNIT, listed on BÉT since November 2024, adds a compact but complete HU-only challenger-bank disclosure set. Two statutory funnels — the BÉT KIBINFO disclosure database (stable /newkibdata PDF paths) and the MNB-run OAM at kozzetetelek.mnb.hu — catch everything these issuers file and should anchor the collection design, with issuer sites used for presentations and richer formatting. The main open work is mechanical rather than discovery: mapping the OAM and BÉT per-issuer query endpoints, and sweeping the foreign-parent Hungarian subsidiaries that also issue bonds.
